commentary.text: 90+7' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+6' 4 - 1 GOAL! A great pass finds Milos Pantovic (Union Berlin) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 4:1.
90+6' A corner kick by Mainz is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).
90+4' Neat passing move from Union Berlin in order to create new attacking opportunities.
90+3' Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
90+2' Tobias Stieler shows the yellow card to Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) for a heavy challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Aissa Laidouni and he is replaced by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
89' Substitution. Kevin Behrens makes way for Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
88' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow pulls off a superb save.
88' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' It’s a PENALTY to Mainz after the VAR review!
87' Referee Tobias Stieler makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Mainz. Let’s see what happens!
86' Surely that's handball by one of the Union Berlin players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
86' Mainz control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nelson Weiper (Mainz) for Danny da Costa.
81' Bo Svensson has decided to make a change. Tom Krauss (Mainz) replaces Anton Stach.
80' Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
76' It will be a substitution. Milos Pantovic (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Brenden Aaronson walks off.
75' Bo Svensson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aymen Barkok (Mainz) replacing Jae-Sung Lee.
74' What a chance that is! Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
70' 3 - 1 Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) heads the ball home after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
70' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
66' Here is a change. David Datro Fofana is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Sheraldo Becker (Union Berlin).
66' Substitution. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) on for Jerome Roussillon.
64' 2 - 1 Anthony Caci (Mainz) struck from medium range. He buried the ball inside the right post.
63' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) wastes a penalty! His shot was not good enough and Frederik Ronnow didn't have much trouble with it.
61' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

61' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Stieler stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. The referee gives a penalty kick to Mainz!!
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brajan Gruda (Mainz) comes onto the pitch for Karim Onisiwo.
60' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Sepp van den Berg (Mainz).
59' Danny da Costa (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Tobias Stieler ignores the protests.
58' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
54' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) crashes a header just wide of the left post from close range after a searching cross. He should have scored!
52' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
51' The foul by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Tobias Stieler.
47' The ball is behind the sideline. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) takes a throw-in.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Stieler saw the whole situation.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle, Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.

45+3' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the top right corner, but Robin Zentner easily deals with the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Union Berlin are going to take it.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
42' Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' A pass by Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
39' The ball has crossed the sideline. Union Berlin are taking a throw-in.
37' Tobias Stieler blows for a foul after Anthony Caci (Mainz) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
36' Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement.
35' Great teamplay by Mainz as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
33' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot.
31' The game is interrupted. Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
31' Danny da Costa (Mainz) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
30' Wow, what an escape. Leandro Barreiro Martins (Mainz) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
29' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
29' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
28' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' A cooling break is underway.
23' The ball spins up and hits the hand of David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will take a corner kick.

21' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Robin Zentner is alert and denies him with a nice save.
18' Some great controlled play and passing from Union Berlin. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
15' A free kick to Mainz.
10' A yellow card for a tackle by Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin). Tobias Stieler doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

9' 2 - 0 The ball hits the back of the net! Aissa Laidouni showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the right post – 2:0.
7' Tobias Stieler couldn't ignore the rough tackle by David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) and blew his whistle.
6' The ball is behind the touchline and Mainz will take a throw-in.
1' 1 - 0 Kevin Behrens (Union Berlin) latches on to a lofted pass and sends a bullet header towards the bottom right corner, going in off the post.
1' The Union Berlin players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
